findings.title: website_name leaks restricted users' website data
findings.body: `:website_name` is exposed as an ordinary serializer attribute while `:website` is protected by `untrusted_attributes`. When `scope.restrict_user_fields?(object)` hides a TL0/new user's website from anonymous viewers, `website_name` is still computed from that hidden value and serialized, leaking the host and, for same/related domains, the full path. The derived attribute needs the same restriction, e.g. by adding it to `untrusted_attributes` or by using an equivalent include guard.

findings.title: Inclusion guard is missing the required question mark
findings.body: `def include_website_name` will not be called by ActiveModel::Serializer; the expected hook is `include_website_name?`. As written, the guard `website.present?` has no effect, so the attribute cannot be omitted when blank/invalid and any intended suppression is bypassed. Rename the method to `include_website_name?`, or rely on `untrusted_attributes` to generate the correct guard.

findings.title: Same-domain check misses common reverse subdomain case
findings.body: The fallback only appends the path when the Discourse hostname ends with the website hostname, such as `forum.example.com` versus `example.com`. It does not handle the reverse common case where Discourse is at `example.com` and the user's website is `www.example.com/path`; the result will be `www.example.com` instead of the intended full path. The hostname comparison should handle both directions or compare registrable domains.

findings.title: Naive suffix comparison can treat unrelated hosts as the same domain
findings.body: The code compares hosts by dropping the first label (`host.split('.')[1..-1]`). This does not account for public suffixes or shared platform domains, so hosts such as `foo.github.io` and `bar.github.io` can be considered the same domain and cause the path to be displayed. A proper registrable-domain/public-suffix-aware comparison would avoid false positives.

findings.title: Untrusted-attribute spec does not cover website_name
findings.body: The test that asserts restricted attributes are omitted lists `website` but not the newly added `website_name`. Because `website_name` is derived from the restricted `website`, the spec should include it, preferably with a populated website, to prevent leaking the derived field for TL0 users viewed anonymously.
